ABOUT RUIXIN

立足如皋，
把配料供应做扎实。Rooted in Rugao.
Focused on your supply.

江苏省 · 南通市 · 如皋市Rugao · Nantong · Jiangsu

如皋市睿鑫食品添加剂有限公司，专注食品添加剂贸易与供应链服务。Rugao Ruixin Food Additives Co., Ltd. focuses on food ingredient trading and supply services.

我们围绕防腐保鲜、品质改良、植物蛋白和天然风味配料，为食品企业对接合适的产品、规格资料和供货安排。立足长三角，服务全国客户。We help food businesses source preservatives, quality improvers, plant proteins and natural flavor ingredients, with specification documents and supply arrangements. Based in the Yangtze River Delta, we serve customers across China.
